notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and favicon, but no preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-12: Searches title, description, and URL, but there is no note field to search.
REF-BM-14: Uses label:tag syntax rather than required #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Supports OR, implicit AND, and minus exclusion, but not explicit AND/NOT or parenthesised groups.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk-action mechanism.
REF-BM-21: No action targeting the whole current filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is fixed to creation date descending with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: No markdown note storage or rendering.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot support.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support.
REF-BM-29: No saved bundles or reusable filter combinations.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings.
